name: SFX_LoadSample
summary: Loads (caches) the sound effect sample id so that later plays start without a file load.
semantics: id is truncated to a signed 16-bit value. Sound::GetOrLoadSample(id, bank entry flags of id): returns the cached sample if it is in the sample cache, else loads the WAV (path format of the sfx folder with %05d of id; a negative id uses the negative-id format with -id) into a new cache node; 0 when the sound system is disabled or the file is missing. On success the sample's volume is set to the bank entry's default volume (0 when id has no bank entry). The answer 1/0 is given through NativeCompletion (synchronous). The sample stays cached until SFX_FreeSample or the cache's own release of unused samples.

name: SFX_PlaySample
returns: int 1 when the sound ended or was cut / 0 could not play
summary: Plays the sample id with explicit length, pitch, volume, priority and pan, and suspends the task until the sound ends.
semantics: Sound::AllocateVoiceAndPlay(group, task, id, length, pitch, volume, priority, (short)pan): picks a free voice (sfxSlotCount voices) or replaces a voice of lower priority (that voice's waiting task is completed with 1); if none -> 0 at once. The sample must be in the cache: if it is not and the sound system is ready, 0 at once (load it with SFX_LoadSample first); while the sound system is not ready the request is deferred on the voice. pitch != 0 changes the rate by exp(pitch*0.0069314718) (100 = one octave up); length 0 = the whole sample, < 0 = endless loop; pan 0..0x80 (0x40 centre; mirrored when the panning state is set, SFX_SetPanningState). On a start failure (device, disabled effects) the answer is 0 at once. Started: the voice remembers the caller and the task WAITS (state 2, savegame return site) until the voice finishes (1), is stopped (SFX_StopSample, 1) or is taken by a higher-priority sound (1). An endless sound keeps the task waiting until it is stopped: call it in a fork.
x3_src: differs: B214/B215 - audio layer (format validation of the sample, playback always from the sample start); otherwise same
bugs: AP 0x0049a985 (AllocateVoiceAndPlay) checks the id/slot only against an upper bound (bugs.md audit list 'only upper bound'); negative values are not rejected. Reproduced in x3_src.

name: SFX_PlaySound
returns: int 1 when the sound ended or was cut / 0 could not play
summary: Plays sound bank entry id (2D, centre pan) with the bank's volume/pitch/priority rules and suspends the task until the sound ends.
semantics: Sound::PlaySfx(group, task, id, volume = argc >= 2 ? arg2 : -1). id = bank*100 + entry; bank >= bank count, an unloaded bank or entry >= the bank's count -> 0 at once. The entry's sample is loaded on demand (a failed load marks the entry broken: 0 now and later). volume < 0 -> the entry's default volume (else 0x100 full); the entry's random volume reduction and random pitch range apply; a looping entry (SFX_LOOP) plays endlessly; priority = the entry's priority unless it is a 3D-control entry. Then as SFX_PlaySample with pan 0x40: the task WAITS until the voice finishes or is stopped/replaced (1); 0 at once when no voice or no start. Stock scripts call it inside fork { } so that the caller does not wait.
x3_src: differs: audio layer (B214/B215); same script-visible flow
bugs: AP Sound::PlaySfx 0x0049b06c: only upper bounds are checked; a negative id gives bank 0 and a negative entry index (C division), reading before the bank's entry array. Reproduced in x3_src (bugs.md audit list).

name: SFX_PlaySound3D
summary: Plays sound bank entry id at scene node node (distance volume and pan relative to the scene's listener cameras) and suspends the task until it ends.
semantics: node = Scene::NodeFromHandle(arg2); invalid handle -> 0 at once. Sound::PlaySfxById(group, task, id, node): same bank checks/loading/volume/pitch rules as SFX_PlaySound (bank default volume, random reduction and pitch, loop flag); the volume and pan come from the emitter's position relative to the audio-enabled cameras (camFlags 8) of the node's scene. Then the task WAITS until the sound ends or is stopped/replaced (1); 0 at once on failure.
x3_src: differs: audio layer (B214/B215/B218/B221 change how it sounds, not the script flow)
bugs: AP Sound::PlaySfxById 0x0049b212/0x0049b51b: upper bounds only, negative id reads before the bank array; reproduced (bugs.md audit list).
notes: The exact distance/pan formula was not read.

name: SFX_LoadMOD
summary: Registers a tracker-music (MOD) file name in a free MOD slot and returns the slot (legacy MOD player).
semantics: The argument is used as a VM string-pool OFFSET (Script::GetStringByOffset(vm, raw value)), not as a string cell - a KC string literal compiles to that; a runtime string will not work. Sound::SfxLoadMod: if MOD music is disabled (sound state flag 8) -> 0. Else the first free slot 1..10 gets attribute 1 and a copy of the name; the answer is the slot (via the completion callback, synchronous); no free slot or allocation failure -> 0. No file is opened: the MOD replay itself is not present in this engine (music plays through the media records).
notes: Whether the slot's id word is set by the original was not verified (the x3_src port only clears it on failure).

name: SFX_PlayMOD
summary: Marks MOD slot slot as the current music (legacy MOD player).
semantics: Sound::SfxPlayMod: MOD disabled or slot without an id -> 0; else current MOD slot = slot, answers 1 (callback, synchronous). slot is not range-checked (16-bit index into the 11-entry slot arrays).
bugs: slot is read as a signed 16-bit index into modIds[11] without a range check (AP 0x0049be20): out-of-range values read outside the module record. Reproduced in x3_src.

name: SFX_StopMOD
summary: Clears the current MOD music slot (legacy MOD player).
semantics: If MOD is disabled (sound state flag 8) answers 0; else current MOD slot = 0 and answers 1.

name: SFX_FreeMOD
summary: Frees MOD slot slot (its name and id).
semantics: Sound::SfxUnloadMod((short)slot): MOD disabled or empty slot -> 0; else clears the slot's id and frees its name; answers 1. No range check of slot.
bugs: Unchecked 16-bit slot index into the 11-entry arrays (AP 0x0049c0b0); reproduced.

name: SFX_SetFXVolume
summary: Sets the sound effects volume setting (EngineConfig audioFxVolume).
semantics: If sound state flag 8 is set answers 0 and changes nothing (the same flag the MOD natives test). Else audioFxVolume = (short)volume and the sound state's fx volume = the same; answers 1. Applies to effects started afterwards (and to the per-voice volume computations).

name: SFX_SetMODVolume
summary: Sets the music volume setting and applies it to the playing music records.
semantics: Sound::SetMusicVolume((short)volume): flag 8 set -> 0. Else audioModVolume = volume; when the music mode is media music (SFX_SetMusicType 3) every media record flagged as music (0x80) gets SetRecordVolume(volume) (0..256 scale, see MOV_SetVolumeMovie). Answers 1.

name: SFX_StopSample
summary: Stops the first playing voice of sound id id; its waiting task gets 1.
semantics: Sound::StopSoundByHandle(id): the first active voice (priority != 0) whose handle == id (the sample/bank id it plays) is released: the channel stops, the task waiting on it (SFX_PlaySound / PlaySample / PlaySound3D) is completed with 1. Answers 1, or 0 if no voice plays id. Only one voice per call.
x3_src: differs: audio layer - the stopped voice fades out over 50 ms (B221); same answer

name: SFX_FindSample
summary: Returns 1 if a voice is currently playing sound id id.
semantics: Sound::IsSfxIdPlaying: scans the sfxSlotCount voices for handle == id with priority != 0. Answers 1/0. (Not a cache lookup despite the name.)

name: SFX_FreeSample
summary: Removes sample id from the sample cache and frees it.
semantics: Sound::FreeSampleById: every cache node with data and this id is unlinked and freed; the sample data is freed; answers 1, or 0 if not cached. Voices still playing it are not stopped here (a bank entry that pointed to it keeps its pointer until reloaded).
notes: What a playing voice or a bank entry pointing at the freed sample does afterwards was not read (possible use after free in the original; not verified).

name: SFX_SetMasterVolume
summary: Sets the master volume setting (primary buffer attenuation (volume-256)*6 hundredths of dB).
semantics: Sound::SfxSetMasterVolume((short)volume): flag 8 set -> 0. audioMasterVolume = volume; if the sound device is ready the primary buffer volume is set to (volume - 256) * 6 hundredths of dB (16-bit; 256 = 0 dB, 0 = -15.4 dB; outside -10000..0 refused) and its pan to centre; then the music volume word is re-stored and, in media-music mode, applied to the music records. Answers 1.
x3_src: differs: the master volume is the audio layer's master gain over all sounds (music, speech, movies too) instead of the primary buffer (sound.cpp comment; not a bugs.md id)

name: SFX_GetMasterVolume
summary: Returns the master volume setting (0 when sound state flag 8 is set).
semantics: Flag 8 set -> 0; else answers EngineConfig audioMasterVolume.

name: SFX_SetMODAttributes
summary: Stores an attribute word for MOD slot slot (legacy MOD player).
semantics: Sound::SfxSetModAttributes(group, (short)value, task, (short)slot): MOD disabled or empty slot -> 0; else modAttributes[slot] = value and answers 1 (callback, synchronous). No range check of slot.

name: SFX_ReadMODAttributes
summary: Returns the attribute word of MOD slot slot (legacy MOD player).
semantics: Sound::SfxGetModSlotValue(group, task, (ushort)slot): MOD disabled or empty slot -> 0; else the signed 16-bit modAttributes[slot] (1 right after SFX_LoadMOD). Synchronous.

name: SFX_GetSampleDuration
summary: Returns the play time in ms of sound bank entry id (loading its sample if needed).
semantics: Sound::GetSfxDurationMs(id): entry = bank table[id/100] entry id%100; entry marked broken -> 0; sample not loaded -> loaded now (failure marks the entry broken, 0). Answers (int)(sample bytes / sample rate * 500) - correct ms only for 16-bit mono samples (other formats give a wrong length).
bugs: AP 0x0049ab40 (0x0049ab5e): no bounds at all - an id whose bank is not loaded reads through a NULL bank pointer (crash), an entry index past the bank's count or a negative id reads outside the bank array. Reproduced in x3_src (SfxBanks::durationMs, sound.cpp:928); listed in bugs.md audit list ('GetSfxDurationMs: no bounds').

name: SFX_SetChannelInfo
summary: No-op: answers 0.
semantics: Calls the caller's group int-completion with 0 (synchronous answer 0); arguments are ignored. If the VM had no completion callback the task would stay waiting (not the case for script calls).

name: SFX_ExportPrivateInfo
summary: Returns a sound-module statistic selected by query (0x4b4 MOD slot limit, 0x4b5 loaded MODs, 0x4b6 cached samples).
semantics: Sound::QueryInfo((ushort)query): 0x4b1 -> 0; 0x4b4 -> 10 (MOD slots); 0x4b5 -> number of MOD slots 1..10 with an id; 0x4b6 -> number of sample cache nodes holding data; anything else -> 0. Answer sign-extended from 16 bits.

name: SFX_SetPanningState
summary: Sets the stereo panning state; non-zero mirrors the pan of sounds started afterwards (left/right swap).
semantics: Sound::SetLastResultAndNotifyOwner: module panning state = (short)state; answers 1. activateChannel uses pan' = 0x80 - pan when the state is non-zero.

name: SFX_GetPanningState
summary: Returns the stereo panning state set by SFX_SetPanningState.
semantics: Sound::NotifyOwnerWithLastResult: answers the module's signed 16-bit panning state through the completion callback (synchronous).

name: SFX_GetMODVolume
summary: Returns the music volume setting.
semantics: Answers EngineConfig audioModVolume (no flag test).

name: SFX_GetFXVolume
summary: Returns the sound effects volume setting.
semantics: Answers EngineConfig audioFxVolume.

name: SFX_GetVoiceVolume
summary: Returns the speech volume setting.
semantics: Answers (short)EngineConfig audioVoiceVolume (sign-extended low 16 bits).

name: SFX_GetFlags
summary: Returns the script-owned SFX flag word stored by SFX_SetFlags.
semantics: Answers the sound module's word +0x104; the engine itself does not read it (a storage word for scripts).

name: SFX_SetFlags
summary: Stores the script-owned SFX flag word.
semantics: Sound module word +0x104 = flags (raw); answers 0. No engine effect.

name: SFX_GetLanguage
summary: Returns the speech language word stored by SFX_SetLanguage.
semantics: Answers the sound module's signed 16-bit language word (+0x108). Stock scripts use it to pick the voice language (telephone codes 44, 49, 33, 7).

name: SFX_SetLanguage
summary: Stores the speech language word.
semantics: Sound module language word = (short)lang; answers 0. No other effect in the engine (scripts read it back with SFX_GetLanguage).

name: SFX_GetVoiceLanguage
summary: Returns lang if it is a language with speech (7, 33, 44, 49), else 0.
semantics: Answers the argument unchanged when it is 7 (Russian), 33 (French), 44 (English) or 49 (German); any other value answers 0.

name: SFX_SetVoiceVolume
summary: Sets the speech volume setting and applies it to the speech media records.
semantics: audioVoiceVolume = (short)volume; Media::SetVoiceVolume: every media record flagged voice (0x100) gets SetRecordVolume(volume) (0..256 scale). Answers 0. No flag-8 test.

name: SFX_SetMusicType
summary: Selects the music mode: 1 and 2 legacy modes, 3 media (soundtrack file) music; anything else none.
semantics: Clears sound state bits 0x80, 0x40 and 0x800, then type 1 sets 0x80, type 2 sets 0x40, type 3 sets 0x800 (media music: the music volume natives apply to the music media records); other values leave all clear. Answers 0.

name: SFX_SetEAXRoom
summary: Sets the EAX reverb room preset (room group and variant) for the 3D sounds.
semantics: Sound::SetReverbEnvironment(room, variant): when the launcher's EAX is on and the EAX device exists, the preset chosen from (room, variant) is sent to the listener's EAX property set; it stays for every 3D sound until the next call (it is not reset when the cut scene ends). Otherwise nothing. Answers 0.
x3_src: differs: B216 - the room applies only while the calling object's cut scene space is alive and ends with it (no reverb in space); the original's Drugged preset at start is gone
bugs: B216 (bugs.md, fixed in x3_src): the room never went back to space - after the first cut scene with a room every 3D sound in space kept that reverb; and the listener started with EAX preset 23 (Drugged).

name: SFX_3DCONTROL
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 0x20, spatial/3D control).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 0x20: the entry is a spatial sound; PlaySfx then uses the default priority 0x100 instead of the entry's priority. Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.

name: SFX_AUTOFREE
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 0x40, free the sample when unused).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 0x40: the cache frees the sample when it is no longer played (releaseUnusedSoundSamples). Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.

name: SFX_DSIK
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 8, DSIK sample format).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 8 (sample loader flag, the old DSIK sound kit format). Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.

name: SFX_INTERPOLATE
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 4, interpolate).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 4 (sample loader flag). Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.

name: SFX_LOOP
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 1, loop) used in the sound type definitions.
semantics: Entry of the SFX flag-name table (AP 0x0054eb60, FL 0x0057ae80) that the sound bank loader matches in the sound definitions; value 1: the sample loops (SFX_PlaySound/PlaySound3D play it endlessly, so a waiting task waits until SFX_StopSample). It is not in the SFX command name table: a KC call to this name does not resolve to a native (the VM answers int 0 for an unresolved name).
notes: Unresolved-name answer taken from the x3_src interpreter (execution_frame.hpp: group 0 answers int 0); not re-checked in the exe.

name: SFX_ONE_MEM_BLOCK
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 2, sample in one memory block).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 2, passed to the sample loader with the entry flags (load as one memory block). Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.

name: SFX_TOBECONTINUED
summary: Not a native: sound bank flag name (value 0x10, to be continued).
semantics: SFX flag-name table entry, value 0x10 (bank entry flag; its consumer was not traced). Not callable; see SFX_LOOP.
